crop.notes: 'Tips. At Home and Abroad' sporting notes column; only the Tom Allen and James Elliott paragraph is about Allen

title.suggested: Allen Fails to Appear for Elliott Match

metadata.notes: Masthead: St. Louis Daily Globe-Democrat, Tuesday Morning, December 12, 1882, page 5

facts.fact: Allen failed to appear at Parson Davies' place in Chicago to put up the preliminary forfeit for a championship prize fight with James Elliott; Elliott and his backer were present

notes: Same news as 670 and 671. Current title wrongly implies both men failed to meet; only Allen was absent.
